QuestInfo.name: [Black Heaven] See You Again, Claudine
QuestInfo.0: The battle of the Black Heaven is over. Go speak with Claudine.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine has returned to Edelstein with her friends after defeating Gelimer. She will return to her cover as a doctor, but the bravery of the Resistance will never be hidden.
